entry.title: Social Summary: September 24, 2026
entry.summary: Bot Screen / Live Desktop Passthrough Launch — The dominant story (8+ posts). NousResearch's official Bot Screen announcement for Hermes Desktop — live-streaming any agent's screen/session with human take-over — was the batch's top post (~367k views), paired with Teknium's companion launch of interactive desktop passthrough for Hermes Agent (~169k views, 1,094 likes). Launch support included official docs via a tonbistudio walkthrough (39k views) and Teknium amplifying the guide video. Sentiment was emphatically positive: replies like "Finallllly!" and "Much needed!" (19k views) frame Bot Screen as a long-requested feature landing with real excitement. oh-my-hermes & Jev ecosystem tooling — The strongest community-builder thread: rlaope announced OMH support for Jev skills, plugins, and model routing (the most-engaged non-launch post), open-sourced jeval for Jev evaluation/visualization, and positioned OMH as an all-in-one plugin for hermes-agent users — signaling healthy grassroots momentum. Official Usage Tips — NousResearch advised users they can run Hermes via iMessage with any model they prefer (13k views). Maintainer Support & Bug Triage — Teknium actively triaged in public: dismissed a reported cache issue pending a reproducible bug report, confirmed a quick fix for a user-reported problem, and corrected attribution that a discussed feature was built by Nous rather than Anthropic. Community chatter — rlaope called Opus 5.5 "crazy" (good) but was lukewarm on Claude Code — timely, given Opus 5.5's 9/22 release. Overall: a high-excitement launch week for Hermes Desktop, strong official-to-community amplification, and visible builder energy in the OMH/Jev ecosystem.
